tagline: Sync Asana project tasks with Jira engineering tickets automatically
metaTitle: Asana + Jira Integration: Asana Tasks to Jira Tickets
metaDescription: Create Jira tickets from Asana tasks and mirror Jira status back to Asana. GAIA keeps product and engineering in sync. See the setup steps.
intro:
Product teams track work in Asana while engineering teams work in Jira. The gap between them is where projects slow down — product managers create tasks that need corresponding tickets, status updates must be manually mirrored across both tools, and neither side has full visibility into the other.

GAIA synchronizes the two so the right information is in both places without double entry. Tasks create tickets. Ticket status changes update the matching task. Product managers see engineering progress in Asana. Engineers see product context in Jira. Both teams work in their preferred tool while GAIA keeps them aligned.

useCases.title: Asana task to Jira ticket creation
useCases.description: When a task requires engineering work, GAIA creates a corresponding ticket with the product context, acceptance criteria, and due date from the task.

useCases.title: Jira status mirrored to Asana
useCases.description: As tickets progress through engineering workflow stages, GAIA updates the linked task status so product managers see real-time engineering progress without checking the tickets.

useCases.title: Deadline alerts on tickets
useCases.description: When a task has a product deadline, GAIA adds that deadline context to the linked ticket so engineers understand the business urgency behind their technical work.

useCases.title: Bug escalation to the product team
useCases.description: High-severity bugs automatically create tasks in the product team's project so product managers can track customer-facing impact and coordinate response communications.

useCases.title: Release planning coordination
useCases.description: Asana release milestones link to Jira fix versions so GAIA can report on what percentage of planned release work is complete, giving product teams accurate launch confidence.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Asana workspace and Jira project. Define the mapping between the two sets of projects.
Set which task events create tickets, which ticket status changes update the task, and how fields map between the two systems.

howItWorks.step: Product and engineering work in their preferred tools
howItWorks.description: GAIA handles all status synchronization automatically. Both teams get the visibility they need without using each other's tools.

faqs.question: Can GAIA map Asana custom fields to Jira custom fields?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom fields on a task can map to custom fields on a ticket so specialized metadata like client name, budget code, or component area is preserved when items sync between the two tools.

faqs.question: What happens if someone updates the task and the ticket at the same time?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses timestamp-based conflict resolution, applying the most recent update as the source of truth. For critical fields, you can configure which tool takes priority in conflict scenarios.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support syncing between portfolios and epics?
faqs.answer: Yes. Portfolios can map to epics, giving product leadership a cross-tool view where portfolio progress reflects the actual issue completion underneath.
